question.worked_solution:
We have the function 

$$
y=(\operatorname{cot}⁡(x))^{\operatorname{cos}⁡(x)}.
$$

First, we take the natural logarithm of both sides:

$$
\begin{aligned}\operatorname{ln}⁡y & =\operatorname{ln}⁡((\operatorname{cot}⁡(x))^{\operatorname{cos}⁡(x)}) \\ \operatorname{ln}⁡y & =\operatorname{cos}⁡(x)\,\operatorname{ln}⁡(\operatorname{cot}⁡(x))\end{aligned}
$$

Next, we differentiate both sides with respect to $x:$

$$
\begin{aligned}\frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}x}(\operatorname{ln}⁡y) & =\frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}x}(\operatorname{cos}⁡(x)\operatorname{ln}⁡(\operatorname{cot}⁡(x))) \\ \frac{1}{y}\cdot {y}^{′} & =(\operatorname{cos}⁡(x))^{′}\cdot (\operatorname{ln}⁡(\operatorname{cot}⁡(x)))+(\operatorname{cos}⁡(x))\cdot {(\operatorname{ln}⁡(\operatorname{cot}⁡(x)))}^{′} \\ \frac{1}{y}\cdot {y}^{′} & =(-\operatorname{sin}⁡(x))\operatorname{ln}⁡(\operatorname{cot}⁡(x))+\operatorname{cos}⁡(x)\cdot (\frac{1}{\operatorname{cot}⁡(x)}\cdot (-{csc}^{2}⁡(x))) \\ \frac{{y}^{′}}{y} & =-\operatorname{sin}⁡(x)\,\operatorname{ln}⁡(\operatorname{cot}⁡(x))-\frac{\operatorname{cos}⁡(x)\,{csc}^{2}⁡(x)}{\operatorname{cot}⁡(x)} \\ \frac{{y}^{′}}{y} & =-\operatorname{sin}⁡(x)\,\operatorname{ln}⁡(\operatorname{cot}⁡(x))-\frac{\operatorname{cos}⁡(x)\,(\frac{1}{{sin}^{2}⁡(x)})}{(\frac{\operatorname{cos}⁡(x)}{\operatorname{sin}⁡(x)})} \\ \frac{{y}^{′}}{y} & =-\operatorname{sin}⁡(x)\,\operatorname{ln}⁡(\operatorname{cot}⁡(x))-\frac{1}{\operatorname{sin}⁡(x)} \\ \frac{{y}^{′}}{y} & =-\operatorname{sin}⁡(x)\,\operatorname{ln}⁡(\operatorname{cot}⁡(x))-\operatorname{csc}⁡(x) \\ \frac{{y}^{′}}{y} & =-(\operatorname{sin}⁡(x)\,\operatorname{ln}⁡(\operatorname{cot}⁡(x))+\operatorname{csc}⁡(x))\end{aligned}
$$

Now, we solve for ${y}^{′}:$

$$
\begin{aligned}{y}^{′} & =-y(\operatorname{sin}⁡(x)\,\operatorname{ln}⁡(\operatorname{cot}⁡(x))+\operatorname{csc}⁡(x))\end{aligned}
$$

Finally, we substitute $y=(\operatorname{cot}⁡(x))^{\operatorname{cos}⁡(x)}:$

$$
\begin{aligned}{y}^{′} & =-(\operatorname{cot}⁡(x))^{\operatorname{cos}⁡(x)}\cdot (\operatorname{sin}⁡(x)\,\operatorname{ln}⁡(\operatorname{cot}⁡(x))+\operatorname{csc}⁡(x))\end{aligned}
$$
